messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: metering anomaly detected in prod-usw2 — token_count drift vs baseline. Severity: high. Symptoms: delayed usage reports + sudden overage flags for ~1200 accounts. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-drift

erica (oncall-sre): I'm on it. grabbing logs and initial scope.

maria (billing-eng): seeing a cluster of overage alerts from the validation layer: `WARN validator: account=acct_23xx flagged_overage=true tokens=1.2M expected=720k` — looks like counts doubled for some emitter shards.

lina (sre): can you paste the emitter logs? any sign of retry storms or duplicate ACKs?

 erica (oncall-sre): tail from collector shows many duplicate message IDs around 02:11:30 UTC: ```2026-03-18T02:11:30Z INFO emitter received id=msg-9a7b retry=1 upstream_status=200``` then repeated with same id and different offset. Hypothesis: downstream acks were slow and emitters retried, aggregator didn't dedupe.

sam (infra): rolling check on emitter-pool scaling — looks like a transient spike in consumer lag on kafka-partition-7 at 02:10: cause: brief GC on aggregator pod `agg-3`. Could explain replays.

maria (billing-eng): customers impacted: primarily mid-tier plans with high-burst workloads. I'm seeing ~800 accounts with overage flags; ~30 accounts have customer alerts sent. Need mitigation to stop more alerts.

billing-ops: please mute automated overage emails for the next 45m while we triage. We should also add a note to the console UI.

erica (oncall-sre): agreed. mitigation plan: 1) mute outbound overage alerts (billing-ops) 2) enable aggregator dedupe flag (hotfix) 3) backfill dedupe + reconcile counts against raw events 4) customer comm draft (product-ops). Executing step 2 now.

sam (infra): ran `kubectl exec -c admin agg-3 -- /bin/sh -c "curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/dedupe/enable"` -> `{"status":"ok","dedupe_mode":"on"}`. Confirmed across agg-0..3.

maria (billing-eng): started a reconciliation job (dry run) to compute corrected tokens per account. ETA ~ 18m. Output sample: `acct_23xx raw=1.18M deduped=590k`.

billing-ops: overage emails muted. Console banner posted: "We are investigating delayed usage reports; transient billing alerts suppressed while we reconcile." :thumbsup:

product-ops: drafting customer message now. Suggest: acknowledge transient incorrect overage alerts + timeline and mitigation + ETA for corrected invoices.

erica (oncall-sre): handoff: I need to leave in 20m — passing to night SRE. Key facts in the handoff: dedupe enabled; reconciliation running; overage alerts suppressed; mitigation reduced new flags to ~5/min from 40/min. Root cause posited: aggregator GC pause -> emitter retries -> duplicate ingestion.

ryan (night-sre): ryan here — taking the bridge. I'll monitor reconciliation and ramp down dedupe only after results validated. If anything spikes, I'll page SRE.

lina (sre): action items for postmortem: add backpressure on collector to avoid replay storms, add idempotency at aggregator ingestion, add alert for long GC pauses on aggregator pods.

maria (billing-eng): will prepare account-level reconciliation report and a list of customers who received emails so CS can prioritize outreach. ETA 2h for full corrections, preliminary reconciliation in 18m.

erica (oncall-sre): thanks all. Summary to include in incident report: impact window ~ 02:10:30-02:14:20 UTC, ~1200 accounts temporarily miscounted, suppressed outbound alerts, dedupe hotfix applied at 02:18:05, reconciliation started 02:19:10.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered to medium — ongoing reconciliation. Log link: https://redwood/logs/insight/1748009999

ryan (night-sre): I'll post an update once reconciliation finishes and attach the final corrected counts. Leaving the channel for now but monitoring.
